final_draft.answer: Two. Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged. The rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: The approved answer (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-17) matches a live check of harborlight/app run on 2026-11-17. The check showed main is protected, needs 2 approving reviews and applies the rule to administrators. Both sources cover only the harborlight/app repository, so the answer says nothing about other repositories.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:8a67b00e-b478-4ce9-9aec-e01c044ae: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:078dd698-c62d-4cce-b017-5094ad078: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:246231ee-a62e-42e2-b586-5679431b6: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:56029c0e-43e4-446f-998e-2d20fe062: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:5d3ef973-83db-47e2-9bb7-bac2cfec8: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
evidence:94ff755d-747a-4edb-be35-8b3c8c2: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 2 approving reviews before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-17 01:09 UTC.
